contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells inside a contained rounded card: image cell and text cell (optional eyebrow paragraph, heading, copy, price and CTA buttons, footnote)

usage: Contained promo card on a section background; default is a dark card surface.
reuseGuidance: alt = light card with image edge to edge; alt-2 = muted (eggshell) card; alt-3 = dark card (image order is authored); app = split card, light media half and dark text half; checklist = light card with check-marked list items.
